THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
089
Behind the image
57 / Golden Collar
REFERENCE 5829.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 042
Art direction: Evening glamour, luminous skin, gold against black, a retro flash-photography feel.
Photorealistic vertical close-up evening portrait of an original adult woman with voluminous dark
brown curly hair parted in the center, warm brown eyes with soft smoky liner, strong defined
brows, luminous glowing skin and rosy-nude lips, looking at the camera with a calm, confident
gaze. She wears long gold beaded drop earrings and a wide graduated bib necklace made of many
fine gold bead chains scattered with tiny crystals, with a pale blue satin camisole top with thin navy
straps. Solid black background, direct on-camera flash, warm golden-bronze palette, retro 2000s
red-carpet feel, no text or logos.
58 / Beret & Pearls
REFERENCE 5828.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 043
Art direction: French-chic black with pearl and gold layering, dewy skin, soft studio gradient.
Photorealistic vertical beauty portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with black hair in a low
braided bun and loose wispy strands framing her face, a black wool beret with a small round gold
medallion, a beauty mark on her cheek, sharp black winged eyeliner, peach-pink blush and glossy
rose lips slightly parted, head tilted with her gaze on the camera. She wears layered necklaces of
pearl strands, a gold chain with pearl drops and a long gold pendant chain over a black
square-neck top. Soft light-gray studio gradient background, dewy luminous skin, black, pearl and
gold palette, no text, watermark or logos.
